transcript.text: Alright everyone, let's get the sign-off meeting started. We're here to finalize the effects plan for Friday's awards-show tribute on the main stage during the 8 PM live broadcast. Per our review agenda, I need to go through this in order. Rafael, can you please confirm the safety configuration for the current draft — specifically the two indoor flame jets at the upstage edge with the audience beginning 2 meters from the stage?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to stop you there, Morgan. After inspecting the stage with the fire marshal this morning, I received written event approval for cold-spark units only — exactly four units, positioned at least 3 meters from the audience, operated by a licensed effects operator. The current draft calling for two indoor flame jets at the upstage edge with the audience 2 meters from the stage does not match this approval. Also, I have not yet uploaded the written approval to the production file.
transcript.speaker: A2
